issues.legal_issue: A verified settlement between the injured persons and the accused may be considered in determining the sentence for a non-compoundable offence.
material_facts: The appeal to the Court was restricted to the question of sentence.
The accused had been convicted of a serious offence that the High Court treated as non-compoundable, and the High Court therefore did not permit the offence to be compounded.
The accused and the injured persons, who belonged to the same family, filed a compromise stating that they had amicably settled their dispute and wished to live in peace.
The High Court referred the compromise for verification, and the compromise was verified.
The accused had already undergone more than four months of imprisonment while the appeal was pending.
issues.conclusion: The compromise could not result in compounding the non-compoundable offence, but it could be taken into account in fixing the sentence. The Court reduced the imprisonment to the period already undergone, conditional on each appellant paying a fine; in default, each was to undergo further imprisonment. It directed that specified portions of the fine, if collected, be paid to the two injured persons as compensation.
issues.legal_principle: Although the offence under Section 326 of the Indian Penal Code was non-compoundable, the fact of compromise could be considered when determining the quantum of sentence. The Court relied on Section 326 read with Section 34 IPC and used a fine, with imprisonment in default, while directing payment of part of the fine as compensation to the injured persons. No earlier cases were cited.

rule.if: appeal_limited_to_sentence and non_compoundable_offence and verified_amicable_settlement and imprisonment_already_served

predicates.appeal_limited_to_sentence: The accused brought an appeal in which the appellate court's consideration was limited to the sentence.
predicates.non_compoundable_offence: The accused had been convicted of an offence that could not be compounded.
predicates.verified_amicable_settlement: The accused and the injured persons reported an amicable settlement, and the settlement was verified by the court.
predicates.imprisonment_already_served: The accused had already undergone a period of imprisonment while the appeal was pending.

issues.definition: When an appeal is limited to sentence, the offence is non-compoundable, the settlement between the accused and injured persons is verified, and imprisonment has already been served, the imprisonment may be reduced to time served subject to a fine and default imprisonment, with compensation paid to injured persons.
